scenes.text: This tutorial covers Make Masks. Interactively construct, correct, and curate segmentation labels for Cellpose training data.
Open Make Masks from the Segmentation models section. Open representative microscopy images and any existing masks that should be refined.
In the main configuration area, select channels, normalization, brush or magic-wand tools, object operations, and label-saving behavior.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. correct boundaries and missing objects across a diverse training subset rather than only easy fields.
When the workflow finishes, paired images and curated label masks are ready for custom Cellpose training.
